approval_gate: Nolan approves every exact post. Silence is not approval.
cadence: runs against every draft before publication
first_installment_sketch: UNKNOWN. The first adversarial review runs against the first real draft produced by any other program in this group. The sketch: the critic's objections on that draft, published with the objections answered or the claim narrowed, as a worked demonstration of the gate.
inputs: a complete draft with its claims, evidence and proof cards
name: ADVERSARIAL TECHNICAL EDITOR
outputs: the draft revised to answer them, or the claims narrowed
purpose: Run an adversarial technical critic against every draft before publication, producing objections the draft must answer or narrowing the claim.
template: Before publication the critic asks: What is overstated? What is not reproduced? What changed since measurement? What is correlation masquerading as causation? What is architecture rather than implementation? What is implemented but unwired? What is tested only with fixtures? What is live? What is inferred? What security claim has not been adversarially tested? What benchmark has no baseline? What limitation is being hidden? Hard constraint: the critic cannot modify evidence; it produces objections only. Content must either answer them or narrow the claim.
